list.name: Anomaly Episodes
list.rawSql:
SELECT StartTime AS time, 'Episode: ' + ISNULL(Severity,'') + ' | ' + ISNULL(PrimaryDetector,'') AS text, 'EPISODE' AS tags
FROM dbo.ACM_Episodes
WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  AND StartTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY StartTime ASC

list.name: Threshold Crossings
list.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS time, Detector + ' crossed ' + Direction + ' at Z=' + CAST(ROUND(ZScore,2) AS nvarchar(20)) AS text, 'THRESHOLD' AS tags
FROM ACM_ThresholdCrossings
WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  AND Timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY Timestamp ASC

panels.description: Duration equipment has been in current alert zone

  (SELECT MIN(Timestamp) FROM dbo.ACM_HealthTimeline WHERE EquipID = $equipment

panels.description: Current detector contributions (latest run)

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT TOP 1 RunID
  FROM dbo.ACM_ContributionTimeline
  WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC
),
latest_ts AS (
  SELECT MAX(Timestamp) AS ts
  FROM dbo.ACM_ContributionTimeline
  WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    AND RunID = (SELECT RunID FROM latest_run)
)
SELECT
  DetectorType AS metric,
  ContributionPct AS value
FROM dbo.ACM_ContributionTimeline
WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  AND RunID = (SELECT RunID FROM latest_run)
  AND Timestamp = (SELECT ts FROM latest_ts)
ORDER BY ContributionPct DESC

panels.description: Detector calibration statistics — z-score distribution quality

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DetectorType AS Detector,
  ROUND(CalibrationScore, 3) AS CalibrationScore,
  ROUND(TrainR2, 3) AS TrainR2,
  ROUND(MeanAbsError, 3) AS MeanAbsError,
  ROUND(P95Error, 3) AS P95Error,
  DatapointsUsed
FROM dbo.ACM_CalibrationSummary
WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  AND RunID = (
    SELECT TOP 1 RunID
    FROM dbo.ACM_CalibrationSummary
    WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC

panels.title: Health Zone State Timeline

panels.description: Defect zone transition events — when equipment crossed zone boundaries

targets.rawSql:
WITH zoned AS (
  SELECT
    h.Timestamp,
    h.HealthZone AS ToZone,
    LAG(h.HealthZone) OVER (ORDER BY h.Timestamp) AS FromZone,
    h.HealthIndex AS HealthAtEvent,
    h.FusedZ
  FROM dbo.ACM_HealthTimeline h
  WHERE h.EquipID = $equipment
    AND h.Timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT TOP 20
  Timestamp,
  'ZONE_TRANSITION' AS EventType,
  FromZone,
  ToZone,
  ROUND(HealthAtEvent, 1) AS HealthAtEvent,
  ROUND(FusedZ, 2) AS FusedZ
FROM zoned
WHERE FromZone IS NOT NULL
  AND FromZone <> ToZone
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC

panels.description: PCA variance explained by component — how many components capture most variance

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT TOP 1
    pm.RunID,
    r.StartedAt,
    pm.ComponentsJson
  FROM dbo.ACM_PCA_Metrics pm
  JOIN dbo.ACM_Runs r ON r.RunID = pm.RunID
  WHERE pm.EquipID = $equipment
  ORDER BY pm.CreatedAt DESC
)
SELECT
  DATEADD(minute, CAST(j.[key] AS int), latest.StartedAt) AS time,
  TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.value') AS float) AS VarianceRatio
FROM latest
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(latest.ComponentsJson) j
WHERE JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.type') = 'variance_ratio'
ORDER BY time

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT TOP 1
    pm.RunID,
    r.StartedAt,
    pm.ComponentsJson
  FROM dbo.ACM_PCA_Metrics pm
  JOIN dbo.ACM_Runs r ON r.RunID = pm.RunID
  WHERE pm.EquipID = $equipment
  ORDER BY pm.CreatedAt DESC
)
SELECT
  DATEADD(minute, CAST(j.[key] AS int), latest.StartedAt) AS time,
  TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.cumulative') AS float) AS CumulativeVariance
FROM latest
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(latest.ComponentsJson) j
WHERE JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.type') = 'variance_ratio'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: PCA Variance Explained by Component

panels.description: Detector cross-correlation matrix — high correlation = detectors fire together

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  Detector1 AS DetectorA,
  Detector2 AS DetectorB,
  ROUND(Correlation, 3) AS PearsonR
FROM dbo.ACM_DetectorCorrelation
WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  AND Detector1 <> Detector2
  AND RunID = (
    SELECT TOP 1 RunID
    FROM dbo.ACM_DetectorCorrelation
    WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC
  )
ORDER BY ABS(Correlation) DESC

panels.description: Data quality issues per sensor — null rates, flatlines, outliers

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 30
  sensor,
  CheckResult,
  ROUND(train_null_pct, 1) AS train_null_pct,
  ROUND(score_null_pct, 1) AS score_null_pct,
  train_flatline_span,
  score_flatline_span
FROM dbo.ACM_DataQuality
WHERE EquipID = $equipment
  AND RunID = (
    SELECT TOP 1 RunID
    FROM dbo.ACM_Runs
    WHERE EquipID = $equipment
    ORDER BY StartedAt DESC
  )
ORDER BY sensor ASC

panels.description: Most recent ACM runs — stage, outcome, rows processed

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 20
  eq.EquipCode AS Equipment,
  r.HealthStatus,
  r.ScoreRowCount,
  r.EpisodeCount,
  r.DurationSeconds,
  CONVERT(varchar(19), r.StartedAt, 120) AS StartedAt
FROM dbo.ACM_Runs r
JOIN dbo.Equipment eq ON eq.EquipID = r.EquipID
WHERE r.EquipID = $equipment
  AND r.StartedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY r.StartedAt DESC
